topic: A teacher receives an unexpected gift from a former student
text: The box arrived without warning, a small, unassuming package that didn’t quite belong in the quiet stack of textbook orders and department memos. My hands lingered over the return address, a name I vaguely remembered from years past, a student whose face flickered in my memory like an old, half-remembered dream. I cut the tape with a precision I didn’t feel, the scissors jittering a bit as I opened it. Inside, nestled in tissue paper, was a familiar novel—dog-eared and inscribed with a message of gratitude. The words blurred for a moment as I tried to swallow the thickness in my throat. I set it down carefully, needing a moment to collect myself before I could face the class again, wondering how many more surprises my past held.
